project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming :: Framework Bindings
project.description: Per-framework CDI/DI wiring for the launcher's launcher-application/launcher-jaxrs - mirrors fowf's own openworkflow-framework-bindings/{quarkus,spring,micronaut} structure exactly (bare directory names, artifactId suffixed -bindings). Scoped to the launcher specifically, not a product-wide shared binding the way fowf's is - the two batch-job runners (executor-pekko/ executor-spark) deliberately have no presence here, since they're plain main() programs with no framework dependency at all.
